name: HIDE
lede: When dining moved outdoors, HIDE extended onto the streets of Piccadilly. Matte black freestanding Tungsten gas heaters keep its gazebo terrace comfortable in an unpredictable London climate.
data: Tungsten Smart-Heat® Freestanding Gas, matte black

hero.caption: Freestanding gas heaters among the tables on the terrace. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: HIDE is a three-storey Michelin-starred restaurant. During the pandemic it extended onto Piccadilly with an alfresco terrace sheltered by gazebos and framed by pampas grass.
With dining limited to outdoors and the weather unpredictable even in summer, guests needed to feel safe and comfortable outside.
Bromic Tungsten Smart-Heat Freestanding gas heaters in matte black stand among the tables, bringing heat to the terrace without fixed mounting.
